Typically, the laws surrounding ranches and horse parks were murky at best. That was the case for the modern world. With motorized vehicles dominating the transportation game and roads being paved constantly to accommodate them, horses had become relegated to a form of luxury and a vintage item for many; though some still retained that special appreciation, and humane societies along with veterans still considered them quite valuable for many a reason, the lawbooks were indifferent and unclear from state to state.
